Starts the workflow when a service calls its secret address with a POST, the call's body and query on the item. The address is in the node's settings once the workflow is saved.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trigger.webhook` |
| Kind | Trigger: starts executions |
| Outputs | `main` |

## Settings

None.

## Items

Each item has these fields. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | anything | The call's body: what its JSON holds, read, or else its text; null for none. |
| `query` | anything | The address's query, by name: ?city=nyc is query.city; a name given more than once, a list. |
| `receivedAt` | time | When the call came. |
